ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a place for {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A close group wants a place of its own for what it does together: a fire pit with seats, a bookcase with a chair, a game table, an instrument or a shrine. Its anchor asks, and the rest of the group at home signs it.

plain.li: [place:fire] Every evening we drag the same four stools out to the same cold ashes. A proper fire pit would do, and we'd keep it lit.
[place:fire] {SUBJECT} sit out by a patch of scorched ground most nights. Give us {THING} and a few seats round it, and we'll stop borrowing the kitchen's.
[place:fire] We keep a fire of an evening, or we try to. Half the time it's three sticks and a lot of smoke. We'd like a real one.
[place:books] We pass the same four books between us and read them sitting on the floor. A shelf and a chair would do a lot of good.
[place:books] {SUBJECT} read every evening, wherever there's a lamp. Build us {THING} and a chair beside it, and we'll keep it tidy.
[place:books] The books live under somebody's bed at the moment. They deserve better, and so do we.
[place:games] We've been playing on a board scratched into a crate lid. {THING} would settle a lot of arguments about whose turn it was.
[place:games] {SUBJECT} have a game night whether there's a table or not. There usually isn't. Could there be?
[place:games] We play with pebbles on the floor of the storeroom, and lose half the pieces every time. We'd like {THING}.
[place:music] We sing well enough, but there's nothing to keep the tune. {THING} would give us something to sing along to.
[place:music] {SUBJECT} have been drumming on the table for weeks. We'd like a proper instrument before somebody breaks the table.
[place:music] Some of us can play, if there was anything here to play on. Could the colony build {THING}?
[place:shrine] We say our prayers behind the barn, out of the wind. We'd like a shrine, somewhere that's meant for it.
[place:shrine] {SUBJECT} pray together most evenings, in whatever corner is empty. A shrine would give us a place to go.
[place:shrine] We'd like {THING}, a quiet place set aside, so that praying isn't something we do in between other things.

warm.li: [place:fire] It's the best part of the day, sitting round the fire together. We'd just like a fire worth sitting round.
[place:books] Reading together is what keeps us going after a long day. A place for it would mean a lot.
[place:games] The game night is when everyone laughs. A table of our own would make it easier to keep going.
[place:music] When we sing, the whole colony stops to listen. An instrument would make it better for everyone.
[place:shrine] We'd like somewhere to pray together, and anyone else would be welcome there too.

blunt.li: [place:fire] We need a fire pit and some seats. Nothing fancy.
[place:books] A bookcase and a chair. That's all we're asking.
[place:games] Build us a game table. The crate lid is warped.
[place:music] Get us an instrument. We'll do the rest.
[place:shrine] We want a shrine. A real one.

cheerful.li: [place:fire] Picture it: a proper fire, everyone round it, somebody telling a story. Can we have that?
[place:games] A game table! We'd play every night, and we'd let you win sometimes.
[place:music] An instrument! We've already picked out the first song.

gloomy.li: [place:fire] Most nights the fire won't catch, and we sit in the dark anyway. A fire pit would help.
[place:books] We read on the floor in the cold. It would be nice not to.
[place:shrine] We pray in a draughty corner, and it doesn't feel like anyone hears.

cold.li: [place:fire] A fire pit with seats would save the wood we waste lighting new fires on bare ground.
[place:books] The books would last longer on a shelf. So would our backs, in a chair.
[place:games] A game table would stop the pieces being lost every week. It's a sensible thing to build.

plain.li: A place of our own. We'll be there tonight.
Thank you. Everyone in the group has already been to look at it.
[promised] The council said it would, and it did. We'll put it to good use.

warm.li: Thank you, from all of us. It already feels like ours.

cheerful.li: It's perfect! We're having our first evening there tonight.

gloomy.li: I didn't think it would happen. Thank you.

cold.li: It will do nicely. The group thanks the council.

plain.li: We'll keep meeting where we always have. It's not so bad.
No place for us, then. We'll manage.

gloomy.li: Nobody thought it mattered. We'll sit on the floor again.

blunt.li: Fine. Same cold corner as before.
